professionalSummary: Nine years of product management experience, including three years leading a team of product managers.
Led the developer platform for a SaaS company since 2022, overseeing three product managers.
Owned API tier pricing and packaging in partnership with the commercial team.
Set the platform roadmap with the product director and conducted quarterly roadmap reviews with engineering leadership.
Coached product managers through a documented practice and maintained clear roadmap boundaries and open decisions.
experienceHighlights: Group Product Manager, Developer Platform (2022–present): managed three product managers; defined roadmap and pricing strategy; coordinated quarterly reviews with engineering leadership.
Senior Product Manager, API Products (2016–2022): drove product strategy and feature delivery for API offerings.
Product Manager, API Products (2016–2022): contributed to product development and market positioning.
